context: Prefer PyPI Trusted Publishing (OIDC from GitHub Actions) over a long-lived API token. Publish 0.3.0 first so the existing tag and wheel are the released artifact, then wire the tag-triggered workflow from release-provenance-hygiene to publish subsequent tags. Verify a clean-environment install resolves and exposes the console script, then tell BenchBox to swap its git pin for a normal version requirement.
description: todo-db is not on PyPI: https://pypi.org/pypi/todo-db/json returns HTTP 404, and the package is not importable or on PATH outside this repo. Consumers therefore cannot depend on it normally. BenchBox is adopting todo-db >= 0.3 to get the 'update' verb (its embedded wrapper has no way to amend an item, so scope/verifications/descriptions there are create-time-only and three separate mis-authored items could not be repaired). With no index release, BenchBox has to pin a git dependency -- todo-db @ git+https://github.com/joeharris76/todo-db@v0.3.0 -- which resolves in CI but gives no version solving, no wheel caching, and no signal when a newer release exists. Distinct from release-provenance-hygiene: that item covers a tag-triggered workflow attaching build artifacts with checksums to a GitHub release, and never mentions PyPI, twine or trusted publishing. This item is specifically getting the distribution onto the index so 'todo-db>=0.3' is a resolvable requirement. v0.3.0 is already tagged and pushed, and a wheel exists at dist/todo_db-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl, so the artifact side is done; what is missing is the publish step and the account/trusted-publisher setup.
